true_duplicate.meaning: the same physical garment listed twice (different retailer wording or photos)

same_garment_alt_wording.meaning: the same physical garment with no attribute change, described in different vocabulary or with reordered clauses

near_duplicate.meaning: one important attribute differs (colour, wash, fit, length, neckline, material), so it is a different garment but the nearest sensible neighbour

same_category_diff_colour.meaning: same garment type and subcategory in a different colourway

same_colour_diff_category.meaning: the shared colour is the only overlapping attribute; unrelated garment classes

related_not_duplicate.meaning: complementary wardrobe roles in one style family (worn together, not similar), so not neighbours in a similarity ranking

hard_negative.meaning: high lexical or material overlap but a genuinely different garment (denim jacket vs denim jeans, bag vs belt, shirt vs shirt dress)

contract.phase: B0 human labels only; Phase B derives the numeric gates from these frozen labels
